rows.detail:
Input: none. Response: {data:ApprovalCircle with all steps}, status active,is_active true.
Rules: only draft activates; previous active version in same scope retires. Institution must end approve, no publish. Ministry requires at least2 steps, exactly one final publish, and preceding review or approve; separate approve is optional. Ordering review before approve before publish. Default MDO review -> MDD publish. Current pending reviewer finishes assigned step; forward transition selects active version without rerunning completed stages. Role+action identifies stages across versions; ambiguous repeated pairs on version change return409. Existing history records remain. Legacy null-stage workflows retain old path.
